name: swiss-activities
description: Travel app for Switzerland: train and public-transport timetables, a rail pass advisor, bookable activities and excursions, attractions and places with opening hours, hiking trails and MeteoSwiss weather.

interface.longDescription:
Swiss Activities is a travel app for Switzerland. Plan trips, day trips and leisure time with live data:

• Trains and public transport: timetables for trains, buses, trams, boats, cable cars and mountain railways across Switzerland, with lines, platforms and transfers, and links to buy train tickets.
• Rail pass advisor: for your dates, stops, nights and ages it prices every train with live fares and compares single tickets, Swiss Half Fare Card, day passes, Swiss Travel Pass and regional passes.
• Attractions: Jungfraujoch, Titlis, Pilatus, Rigi, Rhine Falls and more than 300 other excursion destinations with operating hours and tickets.
• Activities and tickets: more than 3,200 bookable excursions, tours, scenic trains, mountain railway and lake cruise tickets and adventure sports, with live availability, start times and prices for your group.
• Places and opening hours: museums, zoos, playgrounds, public pools and lakes, viewpoints, mountain huts and local events, with opening hours, admission and address.
• Hiking: official Swiss hiking trails with walking time, distance, ascent, trail class, public-transport stops and live closures, plus theme trails for families and winter routes.
• Weather: MeteoSwiss forecasts for the next 7 days and official weather warnings.
• Maps in the chat: results on a swisstopo map with photos, prices and booking links, trails with their route and elevation profile, train connections with their route, and the rail pass comparison side by side.

Covers all of Switzerland, including Zurich, Lucerne, Interlaken, Grindelwald, Zermatt, the Jungfrau region, Geneva, Lausanne, Lugano and St. Moritz. Works in English, German, French, Italian and 26 more languages. Bookings are completed on swissactivities.com.
defaultPrompt: Plan a rainy day in Lucerne with two kids, including the trains.
Which rail pass should I buy for 6 days in Switzerland?
Easy hike near Grindelwald under 3 hours, and the train to get there.

positive.description: Family activities on a rainy day
positive.prompt: We are in Lucerne tomorrow with two kids aged 6 and 9 and it will rain. What can we do?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the forecast, suggests indoor activities and places for children in and around Lucerne with prices, age limits and links.

positive.description: Rail pass advice for a trip
positive.prompt: We land at Zurich Airport in two weeks and stay five nights: two in Lucerne, two in Interlaken and one in Bern. Two adults aged 40 and 38 from the US. Which rail pass pays off?
positive.expected_behavior: Prices the trains between the stops with live fares, ranks single tickets, Swiss Half Fare Card, Swiss Travel Pass and the other passes it could evaluate with total and savings, names the cheapest option and says which products it could not compare exactly.

positive.prompt: Find an easy hike near Grindelwald that takes less than three hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists official trails near Grindelwald with walking time, length, ascent, trail class, public-transport stops and closures.

positive.prompt: When is the Sammlung Rosengart in Lucerne open and how much is the entrance?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the museum and states its opening hours, admission and address as stored, saying so where a value is unknown.

positive.prompt: I need to be in Grindelwald by 10 am tomorrow. Which train should I take from Zürich HB?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns connections arriving before 10:00 with departure times, lines, platforms and transfers in Swiss local time.

negative.prompt: Plan a weekend in Paris with museums and a boat tour.
Pay for the paragliding flight with my credit card right now.
Cancel my booking from last week.

review.commerce_description: The plugin never takes payments. It shows activities with live prices and availability and links to the activity page on swissactivities.com, where the user books and pays on our own website (external checkout).

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3: results now appear on a swisstopo map in the chat — activities, places and attractions with photos, prices and booking links, trails with their route and elevation profile, train connections with their route, and the rail pass comparison side by side. Every place carries its coordinates. Also included: the rail pass advisor for a whole trip, 340 attractions with operating hours and tickets, activities with live availability, places with opening hours, hiking trails, weather and public-transport timetables for Switzerland.

de-DE.subtitle: Reise- & Zug-App Schweiz
de-DE.description: Swiss Activities ist die Reise-App für die Schweiz. Plane Ausflüge, Ferien und Freizeit mit Live-Daten: Fahrplan für Zug, Bus, Tram, Schiff und Bergbahnen mit Gleis und Umstiegen; Swiss Travel Pass, Halbtax, Tageskarten und Regionalpässe; über 3200 buchbare Aktivitäten, Ausflüge und Tickets mit Live-Verfügbarkeit; Ausflugsziele mit Öffnungszeiten; offizielle Wanderwege mit Sperrungen und Themenwegen für Familien; MeteoSwiss-Wetter mit Unwetterwarnungen. Gebucht wird auf swissactivities.com.

fr-FR.subtitle: Appli voyage & train en Suisse
fr-FR.description: Swiss Activities est l'application de voyage pour la Suisse. Planifiez excursions, vacances et loisirs avec des données en direct : horaires des trains, bus, trams, bateaux et remontées mécaniques avec voies et correspondances ; Swiss Travel Pass, abonnement demi-tarif, cartes journalières et abonnements régionaux ; plus de 3200 activités, excursions et billets réservables avec disponibilités en direct ; lieux avec horaires d'ouverture ; sentiers de randonnée officiels avec fermetures et sentiers thématiques pour les familles ; météo et alertes de MétéoSuisse. La réservation se fait sur swissactivities.com.

it-IT.subtitle: App viaggi e treni in Svizzera
it-IT.description: Swiss Activities è l'app di viaggio per la Svizzera. Pianifica gite, vacanze e tempo libero con dati in tempo reale: orari di treni, bus, tram, battelli e impianti di risalita con binari e coincidenze; Swiss Travel Pass, metà-prezzo, carte giornaliere e abbonamenti regionali; oltre 3200 attività, escursioni e biglietti prenotabili con disponibilità in tempo reale; luoghi con orari di apertura; sentieri escursionistici ufficiali con chiusure e sentieri tematici per le famiglie; meteo e allerte di MeteoSvizzera. La prenotazione avviene su swissactivities.com.

es-ES.subtitle: Viajes y trenes en Suiza
es-ES.description: Swiss Activities es la app de viajes para Suiza. Planifica excursiones, vacaciones y ocio con datos en tiempo real: horarios de trenes, autobuses, tranvías, barcos y trenes de montaña con andenes y transbordos; Swiss Travel Pass, Half Fare Card, pases de un día y pases regionales; más de 3200 actividades, excursiones y entradas reservables con disponibilidad en tiempo real; lugares con horarios de apertura; rutas de senderismo oficiales con cierres y rutas temáticas para familias; el tiempo y los avisos de MeteoSuiza. Las reservas se completan en swissactivities.com.

pt-BR.subtitle: Viagens e trens na Suíça
pt-BR.description: Swiss Activities é o app de viagem para a Suíça. Planeje passeios, férias e lazer com dados em tempo real: horários de trens, ônibus, bondes, barcos e trens de montanha com plataformas e conexões; Swiss Travel Pass, Half Fare Card, passes diários e regionais; mais de 3.200 atividades, passeios e ingressos reserváveis com disponibilidade em tempo real; lugares com horários de funcionamento; trilhas oficiais com interdições e trilhas temáticas para famílias; previsão do tempo e alertas da MeteoSwiss. As reservas são concluídas em swissactivities.com.

nl-NL.subtitle: Reis- en trein-app Zwitserland
nl-NL.description: Swiss Activities is de reisapp voor Zwitserland. Plan uitstapjes, vakanties en vrije tijd met live gegevens: dienstregelingen van treinen, bussen, trams, boten en bergbanen met perrons en overstappen; Swiss Travel Pass, Half Fare Card, dagkaarten en regionale passen; meer dan 3200 boekbare activiteiten, excursies en tickets met live beschikbaarheid; bezienswaardigheden met openingstijden; officiële wandelroutes met afsluitingen en themapaden voor gezinnen; weer en waarschuwingen van MeteoSwiss. Boeken doe je op swissactivities.com.

ja-JP.subtitle: スイス旅行と鉄道のアプリ
ja-JP.description: Swiss Activitiesはスイス旅行のためのアプリです。リアルタイムのデータで日帰り旅行や休暇を計画できます。列車・バス・トラム・船・登山鉄道の時刻表（ホームと乗り換え付き）、スイストラベルパス、半額カード、1日乗車券と地域パス、空き状況をリアルタイムで確認できる3,200件以上のアクティビティ・ツアー・チケット、営業時間付きの観光スポット、通行止め情報付きの公式ハイキングコースと家族向けテーマトレイル、MeteoSwissの天気予報と気象警報。予約はswissactivities.comで完了します。

ko-KR.subtitle: 스위스 여행·기차 앱
ko-KR.description: Swiss Activities는 스위스 여행 앱입니다. 실시간 데이터로 당일치기 여행, 휴가, 여가를 계획하세요. 플랫폼과 환승 정보가 포함된 기차·버스·트램·유람선·산악열차 시간표, 스위스 트래블 패스·반액 카드·1일권·지역 패스, 실시간 예약 가능 여부를 확인할 수 있는 3,200개 이상의 액티비티·투어·티켓, 운영 시간이 포함된 명소, 통행 제한 정보가 포함된 공식 하이킹 코스와 가족용 테마 트레일, MeteoSwiss 날씨 예보와 기상 경보를 제공합니다. 예약은 swissactivities.com에서 완료됩니다.

zh-CN.subtitle: 瑞士旅行与火车应用
zh-CN.description: Swiss Activities 是瑞士旅行应用。借助实时数据规划一日游、假期和休闲活动：火车、巴士、电车、游船和登山铁路时刻表（含站台和换乘）；瑞士旅行通票、半价卡、一日票和地区通票；3200 多项可预订的活动、游览和门票，实时显示余位；含开放时间的景点；含封闭信息的官方徒步路线和适合家庭的主题步道；MeteoSwiss 天气预报和天气预警。预订在 swissactivities.com 完成。
